title: Francine betrays the Pitbulls for the Franchise
summary: Shane Douglas’s pursuit of the Television championship intersects with Francine’s change of allegiance. The Pitbulls seek revenge as Douglas uses her help and their injuries to provoke them.

chapters.title: Francine chooses Douglas
chapters.result: Douglas wins the four-way Television title match as Francine turns on the Pitbulls.
chapters.context: The manager becomes the Franchise’s ally, making the championship dispute personal.

chapters.title: Douglas survives the pay-per-view challenge
chapters.result: Douglas defeats Pitbull #2 to retain the Television title.
chapters.context: The challenger cannot complete his revenge on ECW’s first pay-per-view.
